comment: The jump rope idea caught my attention — boxing-style conditioning is a great way to add intensity without needing hours on a machine. One thing I've noticed is that consistency usually comes easier when the goal is a shared routine rather than just finding someone to motivate you. A regular workout time and simple check-ins can make a big difference. Have you thought about setting a fixed weekly schedule with a buddy?
